name: g_live_inventory
comment: Native ten-slot live inventory window.

name: g_inventory_boxes
comment: Authoritative four-box backing storage, 40 words total.

name: g_mkmszr_settings
comment: MKMSZR native GAME SETTINGS state word used by production control options.

name: g_xp_cap_table
comment: Native XP cap/threshold-related table used by tier evaluator.

name: g_native_font
comment: Native font data used by text renderer/width helper.

name: g_special_action_lock
comment: Native special-action lock/state used by action lifecycle proofs.

name: g_actor_list_head
comment: Active actor-list head used by actor_list_insert.

name: g_ice_mode
comment: Native Ice mode used by bounded Ice-Blast-to-pickup proof.

name: g_current_xp
comment: Current native XP value.

name: g_stage_acquired_bits
comment: Stage progression/acquired-bit field; exact meanings are stage-context dependent.

name: g_stage_selector
comment: Live stage/checkpoint selector used for spawn/state routing.

name: g_player_controller
comment: Pointer to player controller/process.

name: g_current_controller
comment: Pointer to current controller/process.

name: g_retrace_ticks
comment: Gameplay retrace/tick counter used by scheduler timing.

name: g_audio_frame_count
comment: Native frame counter advanced by sample DMA cleanup.

name: g_audio_command_index
comment: Alternating audio command-list index.

name: g_audio_info_index
comment: Three-way AudioInfo producer index.

name: g_audio_last_info
comment: Previous output AudioInfo submitted on next service; advances despite rejection.

name: g_audio_extra_samples
comment: Native synthesis reserve; captured value 320.

name: g_wess_tick_count
comment: Native WESS callback count; paired states preserve exact sample-clock relation.

name: g_wess_milliseconds
comment: Integer half of native fixed-point millisecond clock.

name: g_wess_millisecond_fraction
comment: Fractional WESS clock component; tick increment 0x85555 in 16.16.

name: g_audio_synth
comment: ALSynth pointer. Signed-low address reconstruction yields 0x800A8210, not 0x800B8210.

name: g_audio_work_enabled
comment: VI-side gate for native audio_frame_work.

name: g_audio_task_fresh
comment: Task generated during previous VI service, promoted next VI.

name: g_audio_task_queued
comment: Single pending audio task pointer; generation replacement under delay is conditional.

name: g_audio_task_active
comment: Active audio task ownership; dispatcher defers while nonzero.

name: g_audio_command_lists
comment: Two native audio command-list pointers.

name: g_audio_info_buffers
comment: Three native AudioInfo pointers; snapshot records have stride 0xB50, PCM at +0x50.

name: g_audio_min_samples
comment: Native frame minimum, captured 352 stereo sample frames.

name: g_audio_target_samples
comment: Native per-service target, captured 368 stereo sample frames.

name: g_audio_max_samples
comment: Configured PCM frame capacity, captured 704 sample frames.

name: g_audio_player_sample_time
comment: Player callback sample time; paired snapshots equal WESS ticks times 184.

name: g_scheduler_message_queue
comment: OSMesgQueue capacity 32, buffer 0x801AE4C8; no endpoint backlog in paired states.

name: g_vi_callback_count
comment: Native input/VI callback counter; do not equate endpoint difference with wall time.

name: g_default_inventory_template
comment: Stock ten-word default-inventory template, obsolete under MKMSZR after the default loader is replaced. Still written by password `NXCVSZ` (0x8007550C). Former MKMSZR key-to-stage table location until 2026-11-06; do not reuse.

name: g_password_buffer
comment: Six-character password entry buffer (default `BCDFGH`) used by 0x8007550C; the legacy Lua randomizer used it for seed entry.

name: g_options_menu_jump_table
comment: Five-word jump table used by the Options dispatcher 0x800762C4.

name: g_anim_token_jump_table
comment: Sixteen-word jump table for animation interpreter 0x800304C0 tokens 1..16 (dispatch at 0x80030584). See Wiki Data-Structures-and-Encodings (Fighter animation script grammar).

name: g_anim_callback_table
comment: Ten-word animation callback table for token 6; index 0 is null (no-op), 1..9 are the anim_cb_* functions. See Wiki Data-Structures-and-Encodings (Fighter animation script grammar).

name: g_texture_slot_records
comment: 16-byte dynamic texture-slot records (IDs 0x200..0x2FF). See Wiki Data-Structures-and-Encodings (Dynamic gameplay texture-slot record).

name: g_texture_slot_storage
comment: Per-slot storage pointers, indexed by slot ID.

name: g_texture_stack_top
comment: Lowest live dynamic-slot storage address (top-down; reset to 0x80400000).

name: g_texture_bump
comment: Texture-storage bump pointer advanced by 0x8001BF70 without a bound check (reset to 0x8034B000).

name: g_texture_slot_mode
comment: Render-mode index for the next fresh dynamic slot (header bits 0x60); reset to 0 every frame; the Ice helper sets 1.

name: g_slot_render_modes
comment: Four render-mode words indexed by slot header bits 0x60 (all 0x404240).

name: g_slot_render_alpha
comment: Four alpha bytes indexed by slot header bits 0x60: 0x80, 0xC0, 0x40, 0x20.

name: g_image_decode_cursor
comment: Per-frame decode scratch cursor used by 0x8000322C; reset each frame from *0x80112014.

name: g_frame_scratch_base
comment: Per-frame scratch base (0x802C1C00 in the gameplay setters).

name: g_type4_ring
comment: 1024-byte ring of the type-4 decoder 0x80003428; not cleared between images (output byte k at index (1+k) & 0x3FF).

name: g_process_free_list
comment: Free-list head of the 64 process controllers (0x720 bytes each).

name: g_object_free_list
comment: Free-list head of the 79 objects (0x118 bytes each).

name: g_fighter_file_87_base
comment: Resident fighter file 0x87 base (written at stage load 0x8000D34C).

name: g_reaction_table
comment: Victim reaction routine table indexed by strike reaction byte; entry 0x23 is the unused endless-sleep 0x8004E0C0.

name: g_projectile_strike_table
comment: Per-type projectile strike-record pointer table read by 0x8004CE6C; player type 4 selector 0x13 = straight projectile.

name: g_player_voice_table
comment: Player (type 4) voice table: 12 category halfwords -> SFX descriptors 0x20..0x2C; category 11 is the grab.

name: g_texture_upload_queue
comment: Texture upload queue (20-byte entries) filled by 0x8001D6EC; top index at 0x802C16C0 (-1 idle).

name: g_image_type_jump_table
comment: Six-word jump table of 0x8000322C for image types 0..5.
